passive.description:
After killing 9 minions or monsters, Ahri heals.
After taking down an enemy champion, Ahri heals for a greater amount.
passive.name: Essence Theft

spells.description: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.
spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.tooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> on the way out and <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} true damage</trueDamage> on the way back.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Ahri gains a brief burst of Move Speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.
spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.tooltip: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal <magicDamage>{{ singlefiredamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, reduced to <magicDamage>{{ multifiredamage }} damage</magicDamage> beyond the first. She also gains <speed>{{ movementspeed*100 }}% Move Speed</speed> decaying over {{ movementspeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.
spells.name: Charm
spells.tooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for {{ charmduration }} seconds and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.
spells.name: Spirit Rush
spells.tooltip:
Ahri nimbly dashes, firing {{ rmaxtargetspercast }} essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal {{ rcalculateddamage }} magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within {{ rrecastwindow }} seconds.

Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to {{ pdurationextension }} seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to {{ rmaxcasts }} stored).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.description: Amumu's basic attacks <font color='#9b0f5f'>Curse</font> his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.
passive.name: Cursed Touch

spells.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.
spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.tooltip:
Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for {{ stunduration }} second, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their <font color='#9b0f5f'>Curses</font> refreshed.
spells.name: Despair
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Amumu begins crying, dealing <magicDamage>{{ basedamage }} plus {{ totalhealthdamage }}% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies every second and refreshing <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.
spells.name: Tantrum
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Amumu takes {{ damagereduction }} reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdronhit }} seconds.

Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing {{ tantrumdamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>, damaging and stunning them.
spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.tooltip: Amumu flares out his bandages, <status>Stunning</status> for {{ rduration }} seconds, dealing <magicDamage>{{ rcalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and applying <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.description: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.
passive.name: Perseverance

spells.description: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.
spells.name: Decisive Strike
spells.tooltip:
Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains {{ movementspeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movementspeedduration }} second(s).

His next Attack Silences for {{ silenceduration }} seconds and does {{ totaldamage }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.
spells.name: Courage
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Garen has {{ resistsfortooltip }} bonus Armor and {{ resistsfortooltip }} bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants {{ resistgainonkilltooltip }} resists, up to a max of {{ resistmax }}.

Active: Garen steels his courage for {{ drduration }} seconds, reducing incoming damage by {{ drpercent*100 }}%. He also gains {{ totalshield }} Shield and {{ upfronttenacity*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ upfrontduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
spells.name: Judgment
spells.tooltip:
Garen rapidly spins his sword for {{ duration }} seconds, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage {{ f1 }} times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes {{ nearestenemybonus*100 }}% increased damage. Champions hit by {{ stackstoshred }} strikes lose {{ shredamount*100 }}% Armor for {{ shredduration }} seconds.

Recast: Garen ends this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.
spells.name: Demacian Justice
spells.tooltip: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing <trueDamage>{{ basedamage }} plus {{ executedamage*100 }}% missing Health true damage</trueDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.description: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.
passive.name: Get Excited!

spells.description: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.
spells.name: Switcheroo!
spells.tooltip:
Jinx swaps weapons between Fishbones the rocket launcher and Pow-Pow the minigun.

While using the rocket launcher, Jinx's Attacks deal {{ rocketdamage }} physical damage to the target and nearby enemies, gain {{ rocketbonusrange }} range, cost Mana, and scale {{ rocketaspdpenalty*100 }}% less with bonus Attack Speed.

While using the minigun, Jinx's Attacks grant Attack Speed for {{ minigunattackspeedduration }} seconds, stacking up to {{ minigunattackspeedstacks }} times (+{{ minigunattackspeedmax }}% %i:scaleAS% max).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.
spells.name: Zap!
spells.tooltip: Jinx fires a shock blast that deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit, <status>Slows</status> them by {{ slowpercent }}%, and reveals them for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.
spells.name: Flame Chompers!
spells.tooltip: Jinx tosses out 3 chompers that last for {{ grenadeduration }} seconds. They explode on contact with enemy champions, <status>Rooting</status> them for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.
spells.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
spells.tooltip:
Jinx fires a rocket that explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{ damagefloor }} to {{ damagemax }} + {{ percentdamage }}% missing Health physical damage, gaining damage over the first second of travel time. Nearby enemies take {{ aoedamagemult*100 }}% Damage.

Missing Health damage cannot exceed {{ monsterexecutemax }} against Monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.
passive.name: Sunlight

spells.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.tooltip: Leona's next Attack <status>Stuns</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }}</magicDamage> magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
spells.name: Eclipse

Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by {{ flatdamagereduction }} and gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist for {{ armormrduration }} seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional {{ armormrduration }} seconds.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

spells.tooltip: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The last champion struck will be <status>Rooted</status> for {{ rootduration }} seconds and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.tooltip: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing <magicDamage>{{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are <status>Stunned</status> instead of <status>Slowed</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
